hero.subtitle_main: Drink water, train, study, sleep early, and watch your character evolve, drop loot and face bosses.

what.title: The first RPG whose story is your life.
what.subtitle: Not just another habit checklist. It's a full personal progression system: attributes, classes, quests, bosses, loot and ranking. All driven by what you do in the real world.

cards.attrs_text: Strength, Mind, Charisma, Discipline and more. Every quest feeds the right attributes. See where you're strong and where you need training.
cards.missions_text: Set habits by day of the week. Skipped yesterday? The system tracks and deducts XP automatically. Nothing escapes.
cards.bosses_text: From Level 1 to 60. Each boss costs 'Boss Keys' you earn by completing quests. Discipline becomes combat power.
cards.streak_text: Flame calendar: each day with 60%+ quests done becomes a streak. Breaking hurts, keeping it is addictive.
cards.hp_text: Your character mirrors your health. Drink, eat right, sleep. The hero faints if you neglect yourself.
cards.rank_text: Compare your Power Level with adventurers worldwide. Climb by keeping your word.

diff.title: Most habit apps reward you for ticking boxes. LifeOnRPG charges you.
diff.subtitle: The difference is consequence. Here, ignoring a quest hurts the character, and that changes everything.

rows.punish_text: Forgot to log 'drink water' yesterday? The system deducts XP automatically. No excuses, no rewriting history.
rows.gold_text: Bosses drop Gold. Gold buys temporary buffs at the Time Shop. Rewards aren't cosmetic, they shape your next day.
rows.attrs_text: Every quest links to 1 main attribute and up to 2 secondary. You grow balanced, or learn where you're slacking.
rows.talk_text: Contextual notifications: 'You haven't drunk water for 4h', 'Streak at risk tonight', 'Boss unlocked'. Not spam, it's the character calling.
rows.class_text: 55 classes across 6 tiers. Your next class depends on what you prioritized. Warrior becomes Paladin only if you trained the Mind too.
rows.focus_text: No feed to scroll, no social notifications. Open the app, do your quests, close. Focus on what matters.

security.title: Your data is yours. Period.
security.subtitle: LifeOnRPG runs on the same infrastructure used by banks and fintechs, and nothing you log is accessible to third parties.

cards.tls_text: All communication between app and server uses HTTPS/TLS 1.3.
cards.rls_text: Each user only sees their own data. Enforced by database policies, no client-side bypass possible.
cards.track_text: No Facebook pixels, no invasive analytics. Only anonymous error metrics to keep the app stable.
cards.backup_text: Your progress is replicated and versioned. Nothing is lost, not by our bugs, not by changing phones.

roadmap.title: The realm is expanding.
roadmap.subtitle: You're on Beta access, everything new lands automatically in your account.

cards.ai_text: Smart advisor analyzes your habits and suggests personalized quests.
cards.habit_text: Addictions become bosses. Defeat 'Lord Procrastination' with consistent quests.
cards.party_text: Form a group with friends. Everyone must deliver to progress.
cards.loot_text: Expanded loot, crafting and weapons system with real attribute bonuses.

steps.s1_desc: Click the download button below. The .apk file will be saved to your phone's Downloads folder.
steps.s2_desc: Go to Settings → Security → enable 'Unknown sources' or 'Install unknown apps' for your browser.
steps.s3_desc: Use your phone's file manager, go to Downloads and tap the lifeonrpg.apk file.
steps.s4_desc: Confirm the installation. The app icon will appear on your home screen. Log in with the same account as the web version.

faq.q1_title: Is it safe to install the APK?
faq.q1_desc: Yes. The APK is compiled from the same source code as the web version and requests only the necessary permissions (notifications and local storage).
faq.q2_desc: No. Your progress is saved in the cloud. Just log in with the same account in the app.
faq.q3_title: When will it be on the Play Store?
faq.q3_desc: We are preparing the official release. For now, the direct APK is the fastest way to get the app on your phone.
faq.q4_desc: The iOS version is on the roadmap. For now, iPhones can use the installable web version (Add to Home Screen in Safari).

boss.dungeon_1_desc: A damp cave infested with orcs, goblins and giant spiders. The dual boss Shagor and Zoth await in the den.
boss.dungeon_2_desc: Ruins of an ancient empire in the desert. Mummies, scorpions and sand golems guard the secret of the dual boss Sphinx + Djinn.
boss.dungeon_3_desc: The void between worlds. Shadows, dark zombies and young wyverns guard the Void Knight riding the Lightning Wyvern.
boss.power_level_desc: Ranking of the most powerful adventurers
boss.error_start_combat_desc: Could not start combat. Try again.
boss.tour_1_desc: Here you face powerful Bosses in turn-based battle. Defeating bosses gives XP, gold and rare items. The stronger your hero, the more damage you deal!
boss.tour_2_desc: Solo: face bosses individually. Co-op (Dungeon): enter dungeons with other players. Ranking: see who the most powerful heroes on the server are.
boss.tour_3_desc: To challenge a boss you need Keys. Earn keys by completing daily missions. Your key count is shown here — never let them pile up unused!
boss.tour_4_desc: Each boss has an element, HP and recommended minimum level. Fire bosses are weak to water, etc. Study the elements before entering the arena!
boss.dungeon_1_atmosphere: The smell of sweat and rotten flesh fills the air...
boss.dungeon_2_atmosphere: The sands sing as ancient ruins surround you...
boss.dungeon_3_atmosphere: The darkness is alive. Silent bolts tear through the void...
boss.coop_explainer: ⚔️ Dungeons are co-op challenges (2–4 players). With more allies the boss gets stronger, but victory is easier!
boss.how_to_play: How do you want to play?
boss.lobby_host_desc: You are the host. Share the code and start when ready (min. 2 players).
boss.lobby_guest_desc: Waiting for the host to start the dungeon...
boss.waiting_min_players: Waiting for at least 2 players to start...
boss.gap_scales: Dungeon scales by the effective level {{effLv}}.
boss.gap_high: High-level players' ATK will be reduced (sidekick scaling).
boss.keys_hint: 💡 Complete routine missions to earn 🔑 Boss Keys. Each boss costs keys to be challenged!
boss.toast_severe_defeat_desc: You lost 1 level! You are now level {{level}}. Maximum fatigue for the rest of the day.
boss.toast_immortal_defeated_title: 💀 The Immortal Warrior has been defeated!
boss.toast_immortal_defeated_desc: 🗿 The Basilisk Head petrified him. He turned to stone and crumbled!
boss.toast_fragment_desc: "Fragment I — The Forbidden Weapon" added to inventory.
boss.toast_phoenix_escaped_desc: It will return more powerful. Next form: Lv{{level}}. Seek the Trident of Poseidon or the Flame of Ifrit to stop it.
boss.phoenix_fusion_title: The Union of Flame and Riddle
boss.phoenix_fusion_p1: As it falls, the Sphinx of the Desert recognizes in you the hero the Phoenix long sought. The eternal embers of the Reborn Phoenix converge upon the sand guardian.
boss.phoenix_fusion_p2: Fire and riddle intertwine: the Phoenix finally finds its purpose, and the Sphinx, its bearer. The two unite under a single oath — yours.
boss.phoenix_fusion_p3: The Phoenix's journey is complete at your side.
boss.toast_phoenix_fused_desc: The cycle is complete. +{{xp}} XP for the Phoenix's journey.
boss.toast_picareta_desc: Forged from the Golem's core. With it you can free the imprisoned Blacksmith.
boss.ferreiro_p1: Beneath the Golem's rubble, adamantine chains bind an old Blacksmith to the rocks of a forgotten forge.
boss.ferreiro_p2: With the Adamantine Pickaxe in hand, you break the shackles one by one. The Blacksmith breathes free for the first time in ages.
boss.toast_ferreiro_desc: Grateful, the Blacksmith vows to forge for you. +{{xp}} XP.
boss.fenrir_p1: Even defeated, Fenrir is no monster — he is a prisoner of the divine chains the gods forged out of fear.
boss.fenrir_p2: The great wolf looks at you. There is no hatred in his eyes, only the weight of ages of captivity.
boss.fenrir_question: Free Fenrir from the divine chains?
boss.toast_fenrir_ally_desc: The Wolf of Ragnarök will fight by your side against Odin.
boss.toast_fenrir_left_desc: You moved on without freeing Fenrir. He won't be at your side against Odin.
boss.odin_p1: The Allfather does not face a hero alone. With a gesture, Thor and Loki appear at his side: thunder and trickery against you.
boss.odin_p2: It's a three-on-one battle. Expect devastating hammer blows and shadow curses — and far more endurance.
boss.odin_fenrir_ally: Fenrir roars by your side! His fury gives you an edge at the start of the battle.
boss.odin_no_ally: You face the trio alone. Perhaps an ally would have made a difference...
boss.toast_dungeon_defeat_desc: You were defeated. Prepare better and try again.
boss.skeleton_p1: As the Champion Skeleton crumbles, something stirs among the bones scattered on the ground…
boss.skeleton_p2: A skeleton pup — small, confused, fire-eyes blinking — emerges from the mist. It was the champion's child. Now it is alone.
boss.skeleton_p3: It looks at you. Not with anger. With curiosity.
boss.skeleton_question: Do you wish to train this pup and take it as a companion?
boss.skeleton_name_prompt: What name would you give it?
boss.toast_skeleton_left: The pup vanished into the darkness… For now. 💀
boss.toast_skeleton_adopted: 💀 {{name}} decided to follow you! Take good care of it.
boss.toast_skeleton_adopt_error: Error adopting the pup. Try again.
boss.mantiroca_p1: As you approach the Poisonous Mantiroca, a familiar figure appears riding on its back…
boss.mantiroca_p2: It's the Skeleton pup — the same one you refused to take in. It found a new home… and a new purpose.
boss.death_penalty_1_rest: — your current XP progress is discarded
boss.death_penalty_2_rest: — you will have 100% fatigue for the rest of the day, reducing XP gained
boss.death_advice: Make sure your skill loadout is equipped and your HP/MP is in good shape before entering.
boss.events_subtitle: Raids of 10 level-60 heroes — requires a healer in the team

npc.page_subtitle: Interact with NPCs to earn special missions
npc.tour_1_desc: Each week 6 NPCs generate exclusive challenges for you. Completing challenges raises your Affinity with the NPC and gives unique rewards — XP, gold and rare items.
npc.tour_2_desc: Atlas (Body), Nova (Mind), Elara (Soul), Zephyr (Creativity), Midas (Wealth) and Vox (Social). Click a card to see and accept the weekly challenges. Chat to generate personalized missions!

npc.npc_elara_description: Strengthen your emotional resilience by facing inner fears and practicing self-compassion.
npc.npc_zephyr_description: Unleash your creativity with artistic experiments and limitless brainstorming.
npc.npc_midas_description: Master your finances with discipline, planning and financial intelligence applied to daily life.

priority.tour_3_desc: Click here to create a plan. Name your objective, describe the motivation, link the missions and set the target amount. Progress updates automatically.
priority.tour_4_desc: Each card shows current progress vs the goal, the linked missions and the completion percentage. When you reach 100% you win the plan!
